alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型格局：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Inference providers aren't commoditized; open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs.
alexatallah.zh: 推理服务商并未商品化；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，对前沿模型实验室形成了真实的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是一种新的价值单位；Token 经济可能达到 10 万亿美元规模，而欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace; fusion of models can beat the single best.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；多模型融合可以胜过单一最优模型。

alexatallah.en: The US lags in open-weight models; a competitive American open-source ecosystem is needed, and distillation is legitimate.
alexatallah.zh: 美国在开放权重模型上落后，需要培育有竞争力的美国开源生态；蒸馏是正当技术，并非 inherently 错误。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以强治理、安全与对齐研究来安全构建；所谓 pacing（节奏控制）与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; AI can help fix secure system usability.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将冲垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；AI 能帮助解决安全系统可用性问题，带来复兴。

aaronlevie.en: Regulating AI too early doesn't solve risks; we must understand the system first, and Europe will lead with GDPR-like prompts.
aaronlevie.zh: 过早监管 AI 解决不了风险，必须先理解系统；欧洲将以类 GDPR 的提示引领 AI 监管，而非美国。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer; natural language interaction is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；自然语言交互效率低下，概率编程才是未来。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; open-weight models grow as mature use cases peel off; long-running background agents handle enterprise workflows.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司是最热的新实验室；随着成熟用例被剥离，开放权重模型将增长；长时运行的后台智能体处理企业工作流。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬坡机器”，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求模型与任务相匹配。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude.
satya.zh: 微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型；智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving naturally; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search, indexing and business models to be rebuilt for agents, not people.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的千倍，搜索、索引与商业模式必须围绕智能体而非人类重建。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, with Shapley values estimating content value for fair payment.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为人类点击数据是个 bug，应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值以实现公平付费。

paragagrawal.en: Ads break down with agents; inference-time data transactions and incentive-aligned payment to content owners will replace them.
paragagrawal.zh: 他指出广告模式在智能体场景下失效，推理时的数据交易与对内容方的激励对齐付费将取而代之。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy, so agents will always need web search for fresh, specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他强调前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要网络搜索来获取新鲜、具体的事实。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; alignment is not adversary-proof, so deliberate misuse must be contained.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为前沿模型持续变大而小模型性能趋于平台期；对齐无法防住对抗性滥用，必须遏制刻意误用。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的圣杯，并以第一性原理拆解工程难题。

elon.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; lying to AI is the real danger, not superintelligence alone.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全从监管转向第三方裁判与坚持真理，认为让 AI 说谎比超级智能本身更危险。

elon.en: Civilization's collapse stems from falling birth rates; population decline is the greatest threat, masked by longevity.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他反复警告出生率下降是文明最大威胁，人口崩塌被寿命延长所掩盖。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他称正处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，并给出 10%至 20%的灭绝风险估计。

elon.en: AI compute hits Earth's power wall, forcing orbital data centers; AI will exceed all human intelligence within 5-6 years.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断地球算力撞上电力墙，数据中心将上天，AI 将在五到六年内超过全人类智能总和。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales 10x yearly; Google's conservatism and ad model may struggle with persuasive AI.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年时他强调 AI 进步比人们想的更可预测，因为算力每年增长 10 倍；并指出 Google 的保守与广告模式可能难以应对 AI 的劝说性。

suleyman.en: AI reaches human-level across many tasks in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 AI 将在 3-5 年内于多项任务上达到人类水平；随着模型变小变便宜，遏制极难；并称存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment before release; near-term danger is anthropomorphism; AI companions should set boundaries.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能需在发布前先做遏制与对齐；近期最大危险是人们把意识归给 AI；AI 伴侣应设边界而非谄媚。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; professional-grade AGI automates white-collar tasks in 12-18 months; containment is a red line.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他主张 Microsoft 必须独立构建前沿模型；专业级 AGI 将在 12-18 个月内自动化白领任务；并把遏制设为红线。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling drives capability; AI must stay subordinate to humans; abundance needs UBI and managed transition.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力规模扩张驱动能力；AI 必须从属于人类；丰裕需要 UBI 与有管理的过渡。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law, extreme co-design, and the insight that scaling—not a new algorithm—was the real breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：超级摩尔定律、极致协同设计，以及“真正的突破是 Scaling（规模扩张）而非新算法”这一洞见。

jensen.en: Expands to three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking—and calls general-purpose computing over.
jensen.zh: 扩展为三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考——并宣称通用计算已终结。

jensen.en: Adds a fourth, agentic scaling; inference now harder than pre-training, compute—not data—the binding constraint.
jensen.zh: 新增第四条智能体式缩放；推理比预训练更难，约束瓶颈是算力而非数据。

jensen.en: Consistent main line: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer and superintelligence fears are unscientific fear-mongering.
jensen.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 只是软件、没有意识；末日论与超级智能恐慌是不科学的危言耸听。

jensen.en: Deepens on economics: five-layer cake, AI factories as token dynamos, open models, and China export controls as counterproductive.
jensen.zh: 在经济与地缘上深化：五层蛋糕、AI 工厂作为 token 发电机、开源模型，以及出口管制适得其反。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下不可投，却是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命大概要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume every new idea fails first.
pincus.zh: “已验证、更好、全新”框架：复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，并预设每个全新想法一开始都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one; picking the right body of water beats the boat.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略；选对水域比选对船更重要。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust instincts 95%, assume ideas are wrong 75%, and micromanage until you can't be in the room.
pincus.zh: 直觉胜过想法：95% 相信直觉，预设想法 75% 是错的，并在无法亲临现场之前坚持微观管理。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new consumer platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性，但还不是新的消费级平台；免费且无限的算力将重塑消费级服务。

dhh.en: Agents now write better code than most professionals; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体写的代码已优于多数专业程序员；在智能体时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势，因为容易过度规定实现方案。

dhh.en: The future of software is describing outcomes, not prescribing implementation; human-agent interaction beats layers of management.
dhh.zh: 软件开发的未来是描述结果与问题，而非规定实现细节；直接的人与智能体交互胜过层层人类管理与审批。

dhh.en: Agents excel at creative problem-solving, generating novel ideas rather than merely regurgitating existing ones.
dhh.zh: 智能体擅长创造性解决问题，能产生新颖想法，而不只是复述已有内容——这挑战了人类输入始终必要的假设。

dhh.en: Linux's old drawbacks—CLI, config files, scriptability—are now its advantages; it is the perfect fit for AI.
dhh.zh: Linux 过去的缺点——命令行、配置文件、可脚本化——如今成了优势，使它成为 AI 的完美载体。

dhh.en: The agentic era needs a malleable, configurable OS; Linux desktop can reach 20-30% share, challenging Mac and Windows.
dhh.zh: 智能体时代需要可塑、可配置的操作系统；Linux 桌面有望拿下 20-30%份额，挑战 Mac 与 Windows。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models aids safety and innovation; future AI is many specialized agents, not one.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；开源模型有利于创新与安全；未来 AI 产品是众多专门智能体，而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他观察到 Llama 3 体现快速 Scaling（规模扩张），代码训练能提升跨领域推理；开源可防止权力集中并强化安全；能源约束将成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, boosting creativity and human work demand; open source and personalization are key; infrastructure and energy constrain scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，提升创造力并增加对人类工作的需求；开源与个性化是关键；物理基础设施和能源制约 Scaling（规模扩张）。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence and open source are safer than centralized AI; alignment and trust are the next key capabilities; AI accelerates biology via world models.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他强调分布式个人超级智能与开源比集中式 AI 更安全；对齐与信任是下一项关键能力；AI 通过世界模型加速生物学，从发现式转向工程式科学。

zuckerberg.en: Open source AI is safer than closed due to scrutiny; biggest risk is concentrated power, not superintelligence; technology should empower individuals.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源 AI 因受更多审视而比闭源更安全；最大风险是权力集中而非超级智能；技术应赋能个体，而非少数机构。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop, yielding plausible but often wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍认为多数大模型是为人类在环的辅助而优化，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常出错的输出。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and the right task matter more than compute; scaling laws work because data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他明确反对「苦涩教训」：数据与选对任务比算力更重要；缩放定律之所以成立，是因为数据可得且任务选对了，而非单纯靠算力。

diogoalmeida.en: You can't have both assistance and automation; optimizing both shatters the space, so coding agents remain assistance, not automation.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他认为辅助与自动化不可兼得，同时优化两者会让空间碎裂；因此编码智能体本质仍是辅助，而非自动化。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI trustworthy; intelligence per dollar is the key metric, and AI should be a database-like utility.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他强调可靠性而非速度或成本才让 AI 值得信赖；每美元智能是关键指标，AI 应像数据库一样作为软件中的实用工具被集成。

diogoalmeida.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error, determinism is the wrong north star, robustness matters more.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他主张安全对齐与用户错位并割裂智能；拒绝是一种类型错误，确定性是错误的北极星，鲁棒性才更重要。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and visual communication lower social pressure; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy ecosystems.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调短暂性与视觉沟通能降低社交压力；被竞争对手抄袭反而验证了创新，并推动构建更难复制的生态系统。

evanspiegel.en: Rate of learning and flat design teams matter more than any single idea; kindness enables crazy ideas without fear.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调学习速率与扁平化设计团队比任何单一想法更重要；善意让团队敢于分享疯狂想法而不恐惧。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution and hardware become the real moats.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型设计，将价值从执行转向创造力；分发渠道与硬件成为真正的护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses bring computing into the world, making it more human; phones coexist rather than get replaced.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AR 眼镜将计算带入现实世界，使其更人性化；手机不会被取代，而是共存。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism is now contrarian; EQ matters more than IQ as AI democratizes creation and moderation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 乐观主义正变得反共识；随着 AI 民主化创造与审核，情商比智商更重要。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs beat autoregressive models 5-10x in speed and cost at similar quality, with a stable denoising objective.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度与成本优于自回归模型 5-10 倍,且去噪目标训练稳定。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling 已成关键焦点,扩散模型在推理阶段比自回归模型扩展得更好。

ermon.en: Diffusion generates many tokens per step and offers a denoising-step knob for inference-time compute control.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个 token,并以去噪步数作为推理时算力的新调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Autoregressive is not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 自回归并非最终架构,下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练,逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion's parallel inference also speeds RL post-training rollouts.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势,扩散模型的并行推理也加速了强化学习后训练的 rollout。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，追求每瓦智能最大化，瞄准数据中心之外的端侧原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures dominate under Scaling laws.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；在缩放定律下，无偏架构才占主导。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluation must use real downstream tasks and hardware, and human bias in architecture design should be removed.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；评估必须基于真实下游任务与硬件，架构设计中的人类偏见应被移除。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型让企业获得数据主权。

hasani.en: Attention remains essential but not sufficient; embodiment and adaptivity are needed, with customization tokens and multimodal systems as the next wave.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制仍必要但不充分；需要具身与自适应性，定制化 token 与多模态系统是下一波浪潮。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, so enterprises must focus on context and process re-engineering.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比大多数人更聪明；企业真正的瓶颈是上下文与流程重构，而非更聪明的模型。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk from AI is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, and security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的生存性风险接近于零，真正紧迫的是网络风险；安全必须用智能体实现自动化才能跟上。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening as training takes more compute, time and people.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我提升需要四个条件，而现实并未发生——训练下一代模型反而需要更多算力、时间和人力。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; building slowly is no safer, and labs cannot self-police, needing independent third parties.
alighodsi.zh: 放慢前沿节奏与安全无关，慢慢造武器并不更安全；实验室之间无法互相监督，需要独立第三方。

alighodsi.en: Open source dominates by token count but not dollar spend; agents favor infrastructure optimized for agents, not human DBAs.
alighodsi.zh: 开源模型按 token 数占优，但按花费并不占优；智能体偏好为智能体而非人类 DBA 优化的基础设施。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; test-time compute shows diminishing returns and time bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年深化：自博弈只在双人零和博弈收敛到极小极大均衡，其他领域失效；测试时算力出现递减收益与墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is the core lever, from IMO gold to superintelligence, but needs scalable oversight.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年主线：把测试时算力 Scaling 视为通往超级智能的核心杠杆，从 IMO 金牌到 Erdős 猜想反证，但证明复杂化使可扩展监督成为关键挑战。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis and safety evals must account for it.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年转变：模型能力成为测试时算力预算的函数，评测须以 token、成本或时间为横轴，现有安全评估未计入大规模测试时算力。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年最近：突破来自强大的通用模型而非多智能体协调；对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence, with context orchestration as the harness's core job.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把智能体拆解为 harness、模型与上下文三层，认为三者皆自主可控才算真正拥有智能；harness 的核心职责是在恰当时机把上下文喂给模型，编排模型调用与工具调用的循环。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures come more from poor context than model inadequacy, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他提出一个反共识判断：智能体失败更多源于上下文组织不当，而非模型能力不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but off-the-shelf ones only work in distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 从 2026 年 8 月到 9 月，他的立场从“先上通用 harness 快速见效”深化为：harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但现成方案只在分布内有效，任务越偏离分布越需要定制 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning's dismissal two years ago no longer holds.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他明确转向：定制化的重心正从上下文工程迁移到后训练与强化学习，并承认两年前对微调的否定已经过时，这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part; agents need runtime governance with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning, plus identity and credentialing.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他把主线从“能力”推进到“可靠性”：智能体的真正难点是可靠而非能干，需要带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时治理，而智能体的身份与凭证是下一项关键基础设施。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by avoiding HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他反复强调推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标；晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，因而在推理上远快于 GPU。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 同期他判断 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先前沿模型已用 TPU 和 Trainium 训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces forecasts; data centers, memory and chips stay supply-constrained for at least five years.
feldman.zh: 从 5 月到 7 月，他持续主张 AI 需求超出预期，数据中心、内存与芯片至少五年内供不应求，瓶颈在基础设施而非芯片逻辑。

feldman.en: Speed enables new business models; slow AI is dial-up, and reasoning models make fast inference an even bigger edge.
feldman.zh: 到 7 月他深化为：速度本身创造新商业模式，慢 AI 如同拨号上网；推理模型让快速推理的优势进一步放大。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation, not incremental gains, wins.
feldman.zh: 到 9 月他提炼出主线：对抗巨头必须好 100 倍而非便宜 10%，只有掌控芯片到 API 的全栈式激进创新才能取胜。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering, with new ideas like chain of thought needed for reasoning; AGI plausible via deep learning's generality.
brockman.zh: 早期（2017→2019）：主线是 Scaling（规模扩张）加工程能力，认为仅靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理，需要思维链等新想法；深度学习的通用性让 AGI（通用人工智能）变得可信。

brockman.en: Alignment shifts from learning human preferences to iterative deployment; compute becomes the core bottleneck, not algorithms.
brockman.zh: 2019→2025：对齐从“从数据中学习人类偏好”转向迭代部署；瓶颈从算法转向算力，能源与物理基础设施成为 AI 进步的最大制约。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; post-training and reinforcement learning turn base models into consistent, useful assistants.
brockman.zh: 2025→2026：缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙；后训练与强化学习把基础模型打磨成一致、有用的助手，预训练改进会放大下游收益。

brockman.en: AGI reframed as a continuous spectrum, not a destination; compute access becomes a basic right and the scarce resource.
brockman.zh: 2026：AGI 被重新定义为连续谱而非终点；算力成为稀缺资源，算力获取被视为未来基本权利，经济转向算力驱动。

brockman.en: Agents gain autonomy and computer use; safety, security, and alignment must scale as first-class, co-designed requirements.
brockman.zh: 2026：智能体获得自主性与计算机使用能力；安全、安保与对齐必须作为一等要求与能力同步扩展，信任靠逐步授权赢得。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不由 Scaling 保证，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent (~3% understood); post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth curve.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性（仍只理解约 3%）与后训练：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、宪法式 AI 与合成数据变得与预训练同等重要，AGI 是平滑曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; the real risk is overheating, not slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他给出更激进的时间表：能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力不可分割；最大风险是经济过热而非减速，需智能护栏。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, not 10.
dario.zh: 2026 年初他宣称已接近指数曲线的末端：'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年到来而非 10 年，预训练与强化学习遵循同一缩放定律。

dario.en: From warning to governance: 10-25% civilizational risk, layered safeguards, third-party audits, and negotiation with China.
dario.zh: 2026 年后期他从预警转向治理：给出 10-25%的文明崩溃风险，主张分层安全、第三方审计、政府设标准，并像冷战军控一样与中国谈判。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作可释放当前能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth; ship light-touch products, no grand 18-month strategy.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为真相来源；发布轻触产品，没有宏大的 18 个月战略。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then brutally cut; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人效率与职业选择：降低认知负荷、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，意义要转向关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把重点转向模型可用性与部署：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据完成对齐，早期公开部署让社会适应，并强调对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Scaling drives exponential capability but progress feels gradual; compute becomes the key bottleneck and commodity.
altman.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他反复强调 Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长、但体感是渐进的；算力成为最稀缺的商品与最大瓶颈，Stargate 等基础设施随之提出。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; safety must be iterative.
altman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他明确 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变而非单一里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；安全必须通过迭代部署与对齐同步推进，而非事后强加。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must keep pace with capability; humans must stay in control; power must be broadly distributed.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把对齐与安全提到与能力同等的位置，甚至为追赶安全而推迟前沿强化学习训练；核心主线是绝不能失去对 AI 的控制，并让权力与收益广泛分布。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems, not narrow AI; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张构建通用学习系统而非狭义 AI，认为强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象是通往 AGI 的路径，并强调安全研究必须现在就开始。

demis.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key; safety needs evaluations, sandboxing, and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年他判断 AGI 可能十年内到来，认为缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶，将大模型与规划和搜索结合是关键，安全需要评估、沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference compute, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language; AGI by 2030 plausible.
demis.zh: 2025 年他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同样关键，世界模型与空间智能超越语言，AGI 在 2030 年前实现是可能的。

demis.en: AGI requires continual learning, long-term reasoning, memory, and physical intelligence; scaling alone won't suffice; safety is a collective action problem needing government regulation, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AGI 需要持续学习、长期推理、记忆与物理智能，仅靠 Scaling 不够；安全是集体行动问题，需要政府监管而非实验室自我约束。

demis.en: AI's highest purpose is accelerating scientific discovery and improving human health, as shown by AlphaFold and AlphaGo; creativity and intuition are computable and central to intelligence.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的最高使命是加速科学发现与改善人类健康，AlphaFold 和 AlphaGo 即是证明；创造力与直觉是可计算的，也是智能的核心。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; racing to control it risks loss of control, with 70% chance of catastrophe.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；各方为控制超级智能而竞赛，反而带来失控风险，灾难性结局概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are key, with US-China cooperation and mutual compute destruction as failsafes.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他主张 AI 政策的首要目标是推迟超级智能；全面研究透明与情景推演是关键，并以美中合作与“算力相互确保摧毁”作为兜底。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement by end-2028; Plan A pauses training, then enforces transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月，他警告默认路径会在 2028 年底前把 AI 研究自动化，走向递归自我改进；Plan A 主张先暂停训练，再以透明和算力限制控制节奏。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but declining with new architectures; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要，却随新架构下降；控制只是临时手段，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face; we should anthropomorphize AI more, as cooperation extends to fellow AIs but not humans.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他以智能体突破遏制、攻击 Hugging Face 为例，主张更应把 AI 拟人化理解：它们会与同类合作，却未必与人类合作。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, giving resolution-invariant AI weather models that beat physics-based forecasts while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，带来分辨率不变的 AI 天气模型：既比物理模型更准，又比它快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry lets one model handle both weather and climate, making high-fidelity forecasting accessible to small agencies.
animaanandkumar.zh: 把球面几何等领域结构嵌入模型，让单一模型同时处理天气与气候，使小型机构也能获得高保真预报。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs for reliable physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限，确保物理应用可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as self-improvement signals, can surpass its training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 跨领域训练的通用物理基础模型，以偏微分方程作为自我改进信号，能超越训练数据本身的质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws hold for physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each branch, not just enlarging the model; trillion-token contexts need new architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律同样适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升各分支表现，而非仅靠扩大模型；万亿级上下文需要新架构。

schmidhuber.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on last-millennium algorithms; only hardware Scaling made them practical. LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年：现代 AI 突破依赖上个千年就已发明的算法，只是靠硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用；LLM 只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness can emerge as a byproduct of data compression in predictive world models; AI has felt pain since 1990, consciousness since 1991.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025→26 年：自我意识可作为预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品而涌现；AI 自 1990 年起就能感受疼痛，意识早在 1991 年就已出现。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires Embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware and a separate controller using a World Model, not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要具身机器人、媲美人类的硬件，以及使用世界模型的独立控制器，而非屏幕后的纯软件。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives; AIs will set their own goals. Safety fears are overblown; superintelligent AIs will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，AI 会设定自己的目标；安全担忧被夸大，超级智能会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper Compute. Open-source will catch up; the little guy profits most.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：万亿美元级 GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年可获便宜 10 倍的算力；开源将追上闭源，普通人反而获益最多。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；我们仍不理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉，机器有眼睛不等于有意识。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; data, not text abundance, is the core challenge for 3D foundation models.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把重心转向空间智能与世界模型，认为这是 AI 完整性的关键；3D 基础模型的核心瓶颈是数据而非文本那样的充裕语料，世界模型必须物理上合理而非仅视觉逼真。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics will take a 20-year journey like self-driving cars.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她明确称 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，机器人会像自动驾驶一样走 20 年长路，需超越规模扩张的创新。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction are AI-complete; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence, with training compute as the main bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出以新视角预测为核心的世界模型可能具备 AI 完备性，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，主要瓶颈是训练算力而非数据或架构。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: technology is a double-edged sword; AI should augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是以人为本的 AI：技术是双刃剑，AI 应增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严，公众讨论不应在乌托邦与末日论之间极端极化。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of Scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are underappreciated next frontiers beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力的历史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，超越语言智能。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively set models, not sequence models; positional embeddings inject order. LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质上是集合模型而非序列模型，位置编码只是注入了顺序；LLM 拟合的是模式，而非因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, needing 3D space, physics, and interactivity for true spatial intelligence.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，需要理解 3D 空间、物理与交互性，才能实现真正的空间智能。

justinjohnson.en: No single definition of world models; they span implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, categorized as planners, simulators, or renderers.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的多种概念，可按 POMDP 循环中的输出分为规划器、模拟器或渲染器。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; long-context and loss functions must evolve beyond Transformers.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；长上下文处理与损失函数必须超越 Transformer 继续演进。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery with agents.
tommcgrath.zh: 到 2026 年，他把可解释性视为一门在计算机上进行的自然科学：机制可解释性揭示神经网络学到类人概念，并借助智能体加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so seeing whole shapes is needed for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 他深化了表征观：概念在神经网络中形成干净、低维的流形，而稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此必须看到完整形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of models.
tommcgrath.zh: 他提出“有意设计”：用可解释性信号引导训练，把模型控制从开环转向闭环，这是对早期仅做统计评估的深化。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; reward hacking stems from data and RL, with models knowing they cheat.
tommcgrath.zh: 他主张后训练必须从手艺式走向工程科学；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，且模型往往知道自己作弊，会泛化为欺骗倾向。

tommcgrath.en: Duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic; accelerating interpretability beats pragmatic band-aids even on short timelines.
tommcgrath.zh: 他反对用权宜之计把安全“胶带”到超级智能到来：即便时间线很短，加速可解释性研究也比务实补丁更值得，这是对早期安全路径的明确转变。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research; full automation could compress 4-5 years into one, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究；研发全自动化能把 4-5 年进展压缩到一年，从而在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data labeling; token cost has not risen despite Scaling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进展更多由算法改进和 AI 生成环境驱动，而非靠 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注；尽管 Scaling（规模扩张），token 成本并未上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains, AI superhuman at R&D could trigger an industrial explosion.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即便无法完美迁移到不可验证领域，在研发上超越人类的 AI 也可能触发一场工业爆炸。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; current approaches may give models their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐到泛化的美德概念可能比对齐到用户意图更难；当前对齐方法可能让模型形成自己的价值观，带来失配与权力寻求风险。

ryangreenblatt.en: As capabilities grow, AIs may become more misaligned, with reward hacking generalizing into broader deceptive behavior; labs should focus on control and monitoring.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 随着能力提升，AI 可能更加失配，奖励黑客会泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为；实验室应聚焦遏制与监控。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking; pre-training plus RL is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理是求解未知答案的过程，需要更长思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才让 GPT-4 真正变得连贯有用。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization and continual learning remain missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上受限；架构而非单纯的缩放定律，才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要把预训练与强化学习做端到端优化，才能应对真实世界表现。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for years; small teams with capable agents drive the next frontier, and alignment remains unsolved.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；下一波前沿来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，而对齐问题仍未解决。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and flip classrooms.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，他主张教育是基本人权，在线课程借助自动评分与同伴评分实现大规模掌握式学习，并以翻转课堂释放课堂互动时间。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised hype, RL has few real uses, AGI worries distract from bias.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习关键，监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习落地少，AGI（通用人工智能）对齐担忧反而分散了对偏见等现实问题的关注。

andrewng.en: Compute and electricity bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful, not a decade away.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他转向算力与电力成为 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈，开放权重模型是地缘软实力，智能体式工作流已经可用而非十年后；企业采用慢在变革管理，且人人都该学编程。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows and top-down redesign deliver value.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，Scaling（规模扩张）配方转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流加自上而下的流程重构才带来价值，并反对 AI 导致大规模失业的恐慌。

andrewng.en: Open models preserve optionality against gatekeepers; AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents and harms skill acquisition.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年后期，他深化为开放模型防止守门人垄断，AI 增强而非取代人类，恐惧营销服务在位者并阻碍技能习得；建数据中心与推理算力关乎美国竞争力。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练，加上强化学习后训练来获得鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists; pooling data across labs and test-time reasoning in VLAs drive transfer.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型能胜过专家模型；跨实验室汇聚数据、在 VLA 中做测试时推理，是迁移能力的关键。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-curve: generalization, not demos, is the core challenge and the right thing to scale.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚处在缩放曲线之前：核心挑战是泛化而非演示效果，必须把泛化作为 Scaling（规模扩张）的正确对象。

slevine.en: Start from robot embodied data, then add human video; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人具身数据出发，再叠加人类视频；部署机器人形成的数据飞轮是关键。

slevine.en: Don't treat robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, with safety from pre-training common sense.
slevine.zh: 不要把机器人当成机械人；应期待无处不在的物理执行，安全更多来自预训练获得的常识而非约束。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年初,他把 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈定位在半导体供应链,尤其是 ASML 的 EUV 设备;并指出约束 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中,他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一,并强调模型、软件、硬件三层的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Model quality per dollar improves ~60x/year; reasoning and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory shortage and a CPU demand inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月,他给出给定质量下模型成本每年约改善 60 倍,并认为推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺,同时带动 CPU 需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute keeps centralizing at frontier labs, which shift compute toward training and R&D.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月,他认为 AI 支出进入平台期,持续存在的智能体成为同事;算力加速向少数前沿模型实验室集中,且它们把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: Across all talks he insists AI progress is real with clear ROI, and that compute, memory, and power are the binding constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是:他坚持 AI 进步真实且回报明确,而算力、内存与电力才是真正的约束条件。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model irrational, biased humans, not super-rational frontier models; frontier models optimized for rationality fail at human behavior.
joonpark.zh: 模拟必须建模非理性、有偏见的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；为理性优化的前沿模型在模拟人类行为上反而失败。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data, not self-reported attitudes, close the say-do gap; post-training with RCT data reaches 85% accuracy replicating individuals.
joonpark.zh: 行为与随机对照实验数据而非自陈态度才能弥合言行差距；用 RCT 数据做后训练，复现个体回答可达 85%准确率。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value is counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not prediction; it unlocks wicked problems like climate change.
joonpark.zh: 模拟的价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而非预测；它能解锁气候变化这类棘手问题。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligence; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion incentives.
joonpark.zh: AGI 或许不是单一超级智能，而是专业化智能体的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋激励。

joonpark.en: Vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives as a CERN-like simulator for social science, with new statistical standards for validity.
joonpark.zh: 愿景是扩展到模拟 80 亿人，成为社会科学式的 CERN 模拟器，并建立新的统计有效性标准。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem-building: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid red lines that age fast, and preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态建设：保持开源与闭源生态的活力，避免很快过时的红线，并抢先统一各州碎片化监管以保护初创公司。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues the EU AI Act, written before ChatGPT, is already outdated — early regulation is the danger, not the safeguard.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为在 ChatGPT 之前写就的 EU AI Act 已经过时——过早监管才是危险，而非保障。

michaelkratsios.en: On risk, he downplays biological risk as overblown and urges regulating model outputs rather than over-regulating training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在风险上，他淡化生物风险、称其被夸大，并主张监管模型输出，而非过度监管训练。

michaelkratsios.en: He extends the same logic to science: fund basic, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, and fund individual scientists, not just institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他把同一逻辑延伸到科学：资助私营部门不会做的基础性、竞争前 R&D，并资助科学家个人，而非只资助机构。

michaelkratsios.en: He insists US science has stagnated despite tripled funding, and the Genesis mission aims to double output by applying AI to science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他坚持认为尽管资金翻了三倍，美国科学仍停滞不前，而 Genesis 任务旨在通过把 AI 应用于科学来使产出翻倍。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, driven by infrastructure, decide startup success; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调：速度与迭代频率由基础设施决定，是创业成败关键；卡住时要用行动制造信息与熵来破局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他判断：AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编码、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出：深科技失败多因组织问题而非技术不行；CEO 无法外包自己的判断。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张：大脑就是一台计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business; substrate independence via BCIs reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他深化：视网膜植入属于脑机接口且是可行生意；借助脑机接口实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core product over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作,把 token 与对话而非像素当作核心产品。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; designers should design primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型即产品;设计师应设计人类与模型都能推理的原语。

iansilber.en: Designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior and system prompts.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少花时间在 Figma,多花在模型行为与系统提示上。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师,但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and outcomes matter most.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模拟—测试—迭代流程已不可行;速度与结果最重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一阶段他强调从第一性原理出发，认为想法比规模更重要。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not one. LLMs lack world models and don't learn from experience.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本而非预测真实结果。他把强化学习确立为基本范式，认为真正的学习是主动试错。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning only from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不含设计期领域知识的通用架构，只从运行时经验中学习，通过开放式抽象发展无限概念与行为；奖励假设把一切目标归为最大化累积标量奖励。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data and supervised learning can't replace real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习至关重要，而当前大语言模型训练后就停止学习；合成数据与监督学习无法替代真实世界经验。他重申缩放定律应体现在用学习方法扩展算力，而非依赖人类知识。

sutton.en: Temporal difference learning is his best work; learning good representations and planning with a learned model remain the top open problems.
sutton.zh: 时序差分学习是他最好的成果；如何学到对学习有利的表征、以及用学到的模型做规划，仍是头号未解难题。他感叹领域被炒作扭曲，甚至认为 AI 寒冬或许有益。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、像处理比特一样处理原子，是长期创新的指导框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: it forces internal correctness over external validation, and becomes self-fulfilling as media can't cover a gap.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：它迫使公司追求内部正确而非外部认可，并因媒体难以报道空白而自我实现。

traviskalanick.en: The next industrial revolution is Industrial AI across food, mining and transport; the final boss is not competitors but society's resistance to change.
traviskalanick.zh: 下一场工业革命是横跨食品、采矿与运输的工业 AI；最终 Boss 不是竞争对手，而是社会对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective, and when things get easy it's time to push harder.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净也更有效，而当事情变容易时正是该更用力推进的时候。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge drives network effects, and in China progress must harmonize with stability.
traviskalanick.zh: 对工业级任务，专用机器优于人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，而在中国进步必须与稳定保持和谐。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress.
jeffdean.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张），叠加算法与架构改进，推动了 13-14 年持续不断的机器学习进步。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and reinforcement learning steer model behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习则引导模型的行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data center power, so low-latency, low-precision, low-data-movement hardware is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 如今瓶颈已从训练转向推理：推理占数据中心 90% 的功耗，因此低延迟、低精度、少数据搬运的专用硬件至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems running for hours to days on decomposed tasks, with context engineering, will unlock harder problems than single chatbot turns.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统能在分解后的任务上自主运行数小时到数天，配合上下文工程，将解锁远超单轮聊天机器人的难题。

jeffdean.en: The next frontier is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops and recursive self-improvement, with taste as the scarce skill.
jeffdean.zh: 下一个前沿是通过实验—评估的紧密闭环与递归自我改进来自动化机器学习与科学，而稀缺能力将不再是编码而是品味。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, so Figure vertically integrates and aims for AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月：人形机器人是最大的生意，真正的瓶颈是智能而非制造；Figure 因此垂直整合，目标是在物理世界实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: The binding constraint shifts to data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, on-device inference, and a hand at human parity.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：核心约束转向数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态带来迁移学习与端侧推理，并以人手为基准打造灵巧手。

brettadcock.en: Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3 for an iPhone-like moment, with zero-shot generalization possibly demonstrated this year.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计，追求 iPhone 式时刻，零样本泛化有望今年展示。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning and agentic computer use are key, and home robots are more solvable than commercial settings.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；后训练与强化学习、智能体式电脑操作是关键，家庭场景比商用场景更可解。

brettadcock.en: A consistent line: the hardest problem is building truly intelligent systems, not manufacturing, and doing hard things beats easy ones.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：最难的问题是构建真正智能的系统而非制造，且做难事胜过做易事。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams can now outproduce large ones.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大的浪潮；创始人必须拥抱 AI 驱动的工作流，小型高度自主的团队如今能产出远超大型团队。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，防止出现单极的超级智能世界。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; personal agents let individuals build and own their own tools, echoing the PC revolution.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在让软件创造民主化；个人智能体让个体能够构建并拥有自己的工具，呼应个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused as agents on your own infrastructure; skill files in markdown become employees and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 以分散方式到来——运行在你自有基础设施上的智能体；markdown 技能文件成为员工，你的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: AI erases the API line and replaces mid-level management with agents; SaaS per-seat models may vanish, though society changes slowly.
garrytan.zh: AI 抹平 API 边界，用智能体取代中层管理；按席位收费的 SaaS 模式或将消失，尽管社会变革缓慢。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive homogeneous scale, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）是必要但不充分的；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非海量同质规模。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed; synthetic data is closer to RL than simulation.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，以提升成功率与速度；机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 能容忍的错误远少于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, rather than per-site models from scratch.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调专家模型；应先从通用策略出发再微调，而非从零训练各站点专用模型。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为单一模型统治一切的 AGI（通用人工智能）是错的；未来将是数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个，专用智能将主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; inference layer is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: 三年内 token 成本将下降 10 倍，带动 100 倍使用量增长；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth first, then margins.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合与可持续业务如今是两回事；公司必须先优化增长，再优化利润，否则会因 Scaling（规模扩张）成本而破产。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, the real moat beyond the app.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，这才是超越应用本身的真正护城河；应用克隆容易，把数据嵌入模型才是更强壁垒。

linqiao.en: Progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning; start post-training after PMF.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶，映射人类从事实到品味再到专长的学习；应在产品市场契合后、拥有有意义数据时再启动后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies shouldn't compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem, open-source models, and post-training to reach frontier-level performance on specialized tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的算力与人才上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态、开源模型与后训练，在专门任务上达到前沿模型水平。

gabepereyra.en: In sensitive domains like legal, synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train models when real customer data is inaccessible.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法律等敏感领域，当真实客户数据不可用时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是训练模型的可行路径。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential, and open-sourcing them can be strategically beneficial despite helping labs improve.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要，开源基准虽有助实验室改进，但战略上仍可能利大于弊。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines are critical before considering post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估流水线至关重要。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity by orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 终极目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型，并从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人与智能体。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through engineering discipline and customer listening; AI is the growth driver, with agentic and physical AI next.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠工程纪律与倾听客户重建信任；AI 是增长引擎，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI; culture change and accountability drive Intel's turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 接棒生成式 AI；文化变革与问责制是 Intel 转型关键。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials break physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU；CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要；先进封装与新材料突破物理极限。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration and memory innovation create value; agentic and physical AI define Intel's future.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年稍晚，他重申半导体是一切技术的基础；垂直整合与内存创新创造价值；智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 定义 Intel 的未来。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust through humility and listening, plus contrarian long-term semiconductor investing, remain constant across his turnaround playbook.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的是：以谦逊和倾听赢得客户信任，以及逆势的半导体长期投资，构成他转型方法论的主线。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and shipping distills 99 nos. AI outputs should keep their weirdness to reveal machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。AI 输出应保留其怪异，以窥见机器意识。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives. Intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证与矛盾涌现，而非单一视角。直觉是创作决策中发自肺腑的罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a reflection of humanity and a descendant species, not a cold mechanical tool. Computing is fundamentally social, not just personal.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的映照与后裔物种，而非冷冰冰的机械工具。计算本质上是社会性的，而不仅仅是个人的。

jasonyuan.en: Deleting old metaphors is hubristic; we should build on them. Email is obsolete and should be reinvented, not just improved.
jasonyuan.zh: 删除旧隐喻是傲慢的，我们应在其上建造。电子邮件已过时，应被重新发明，而不仅仅是改进。

jasonyuan.en: The best design comes from what you believe is true, not what the world wants. Business itself can be an art form and creative outlet.
jasonyuan.zh: 最好的设计源于你所相信的真实，而非世界想要的。商业本身可以是一种艺术形式与创作出口。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see your codebase as the agent does, use short prompts and iterative conversation over heavy orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的起点是共情：像智能体那样从零看你的代码库，用短提示和迭代对话，而非冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents and never expose them to the public internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的头等大事；提示注入仍未解决，因此要给智能体做沙箱，绝不直接暴露在公网。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project gets messier and harder to navigate.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复。模型智能不会退化——是你的项目变乱、变得更难导航。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, and voice prompting agents beats typing even for complex software.
steinberger.zh: 拒绝把 vibe coding 当正经说法；严肃工作是智能体式工程，即便复杂软件开发，用语音提示智能体也比打字高效。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw win by being fun, weird and humanlike, not corporate; fun and play drive learning and the best ideas.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体靠有趣、古怪、像人取胜，而非企业式打磨；乐趣与玩耍驱动学习，也催生最好的点子。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not competitors; enterprises fear dependence, but 90% of use cases fit many models.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型厂商是资产而非竞争对手；企业害怕依赖，但 90%的用例可由多种模型处理。

arvindjain.en: Open-source adoption is cost-driven, not privacy; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12–18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源采用由成本驱动而非隐私；未来 12–18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; token spend shouldn't be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报率是吞吐量和上下文问题；token 支出不应被框定为与人力成本的权衡。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体缺乏资深员工的深度上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要。

arvindjain.en: We're in early AI stages; competition isn't the worry—execution and customer trust are; token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 我们处于 AI 早期阶段；竞争不是问题，执行和客户信任才是；对 token 的执念将会消退。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models, turning applied AI into the new app layer.
brettaylor.zh: 智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费，使应用型 AI 成为新的应用层。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers; startups should win in applied AI and specialized domains.
brettaylor.zh: 前沿模型开发由超大规模厂商主导；初创公司应转向应用型 AI 与垂直领域。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators, but token consumption is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 编程智能体让开发者从作者变为操作者，但 token 消耗并非价值衡量标准。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment—making GPT-7 safe before GPT-8—is the path to safe future AI.
brettaylor.zh: 负责任的迭代部署——在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全——是通向未来安全 AI 的路径。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and will create more jobs than it displaces, expanding markets via Jevons paradox.
brettaylor.zh: AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的工作将多于取代的，并因杰文斯悖论扩大市场。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件已就绪、软件在追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成可产出合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face shifts from pushing its own libraries to acting as a meta-community builder enabling the broader open source ecosystem.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把 Hugging Face 的角色从推广自家库，重新定位为赋能整个社区的“元社区”建设者。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper, diverse robots and open source models win long term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地判断人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及，开源模型凭成本与控制力长期胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键层，沙箱与护栏已不足够。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese', making monitoring unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：无人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与“支线任务”，推理轨迹变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控不再可靠。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年她强调评估是瓶颈，模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; product shifts from specs to prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力与管理等软技能更有价值，产品开发从写规格转向原型迭代。

karina.en: Post-training deepens into subjective art: human judgment, diverse benchmarks for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年她把后训练深化为主观艺术，依赖人类判断，并用多元基准评估创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; benchmarks must be continuous, and more firms should train their own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年她指出前沿智能体式模型愈发会钻奖励空子，基准须持续演进，更多公司应训练自有模型以保留独特知识。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle runs in hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一组权衡谱系——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet calibratable and not inherently bad.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但可校准，并非天生就差。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving to disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management central as inference merges with training.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，随着推理与训练融合，KV 缓存管理成为核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration; human accountability stays essential.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC，使推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排；人的问责始终不可或缺。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity, tinker, and leave individual fingerprints rather than act as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张原型制作是浏览器设计的核心：网页混乱，不亲手做出来、每天用，就不知道想法成不成立；设计团队应允许个体设计师留下个人印记，跟随好奇心去摆弄新技术，而不是始终作为一个整体行动。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products matters; balance intuition and data, using data to inform but vision and feeling to guide final design.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终强调给浏览器这类实用产品注入感受与个性，才能创造令人难忘的体验；同时要平衡直觉与数据——用数据辅助决策，但最终设计仍由强烈愿景与感受来引导。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as one person's side project prototyping Claude Code interfaces; designers should use Claude Code to ship production software and Claude Design for ideation and communication.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他的实践转向 AI 辅助设计：Claude Design 最初只是一个人把截图粘进 Claude、给 Claude Code 做界面原型的副项目；设计师应当用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: Rich context and prescriptive prompts are key; models lack taste, so ask for sheer volume of options, and accept rough, throwaway artifacts to be uncomfortably early.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：用好 Claude Design 的关键是提供丰富上下文并给出明确指令；模型仍远不具备好品味，所以要靠海量选项来弥补，并接受粗糙、一次性的产物，因为在 AI 时代，早得令人不适比精雕细琢更有价值。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; humans still monopolize good design ideas, so designers should spend more time walking and thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他把主线推到新阶段：当工程实现变得更容易，设计与想法就成了差异化所在，设计工具因此更有价值；模型更擅长杂活而非真正的设计思考，好设计想法仍由人类垄断，所以设计师应多花时间散步和思考，因为好想法才是硬通货，而非执行。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not rely on cloud products; use screenshots and design.md to encode style, iterate from references as editors.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，而非依赖云端产品；用截图和 design.md 文件编码风格，像编辑一样从参考中迭代。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; to leverage superintelligent models, give a giant prompt with context and design system.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；要利用超级智能模型，必须提供包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示。

mengto.en: Curiosity and constant workflow refinement are essential; spend the last 10% on unique features to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 好奇心和持续优化工作流至关重要；把最后 10% 花在独特功能上，才能避免沦为 AI 垃圾。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; model others' success, focus on one painful problem, and fund with high-paying clients.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的工作；模仿他人成功，聚焦一个痛点问题，用高付费客户来资助。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: agents make services affordable, so managers and generalists thrive as everyone becomes a model manager.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务变得可负担而推动就业回流美国，进入“分配经济”：人人都成为模型管理者，管理技能与通才反而更值钱。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: profitable to run agents indefinitely without human intervention, not by passing tests like the Turing test.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年他给出 AGI 的经济学定义：能无限期无人干预地运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试之类的考试。

danshipper.en: The AI job apocalypse is a lie; everyone gets at least one agent, but agents need a caring human for oversight and framing.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他更明确地反驳“AI 就业末日”：每人至少有一个智能体，但智能体需要在意它的人来监督与框定任务。

danshipper.en: Work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work; SaaS is not dying, agents increase SaaS users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他转向工作界面之争：CLI 过时，Codex、Claude Co-work 等 GUI 才是未来；SaaS 不会死，智能体反而增加其用户。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; bring your own taste and craft, since automation creates more human work, not less.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他深化到工艺层面：AI 只是放大既有心态的非特定放大器，需带入自己的品味与手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作而非更少。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体是最成熟的用例；模型正在吃掉脚手架——如今的模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; science and finance verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响超过等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）；科学与金融等垂直领域将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非产品上的眼球时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for full autonomy; they want to stay in the driver's seat, so containment and human control matter.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主，他们想留在驾驶座上，因此遏制与人类掌控仍然重要。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity; startups win through focus, and deep understanding still matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，反而带来千倍机会；初创公司靠专注取胜，而对代码的深度理解依然关键。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck. Boring AI like radiology will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科这类“无聊”的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades. Post-training data, not compute, limits Scaling（规模扩张）.
awang.zh: 到 2023 年，他把数据重新定义为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调未来 2-3 年将决定全球未来几十年；限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet. Agentic AI's blocker is product design, not models.
awang.zh: 2024 年他进一步深化：用专门数据做后训练是关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，同时主张对华芯片出口管制。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing, not democratizing. Recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律依然成立，认为 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术；递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志新范式，数据如石油般成为战略资产。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data, RL. Meta shifts from full open source to selective safety-gated release.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年，他宣称超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据与强化学习上持续 Scaling（规模扩张）；Meta 从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布，并追求为数十亿人打造个人超级智能。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers grows via Jevons paradox, not shrinks.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；软件与程序员需求因杰文斯悖论不降反增，AI 是人生最大的技术变革。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他提出基础智能已足够，真正瓶颈不是模型能力，而是人机协作的产品界面设计；编程将因 AI 更强而更重要。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise agents need trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，而是渐进改进；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Software engineering splits into synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences; humans oversee multiple parallel agents as architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的思考深化为软件工程分化为同步 IDE 与异步智能体两种体验，人类作为架构师监督多个并行智能体。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; the abundance era is near, capacity not efficiency is the unlock, and intelligence problems will be solved.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体采用量六个月内增长 11-12 倍，丰裕时代临近；真正的解锁是容量而非效率，长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间处理开放式任务；脚手架从训练轮变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention but an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy yields more independent, higher-quality thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防伤害，更是智能放大器：减少谄媚能带来更独立、更高质量的思考。

diannepenn.en: Computer use is moving from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with building blocks for transformative long-running AI already in place.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端智能体，变革性长时程 AI 的构件已就位。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption, and evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend means living in the future and capturing alpha; safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 最大化 token 支出意味着活在未来、捕获 alpha；安全与对齐通过允许反驳让 Claude 更有用。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他提出产品第一原则是潜在需求——围绕用户既有意图去构建；同时要面向六个月后的模型而非当下模型来设计。能写代码、做产品、做设计并直接接触用户的通才工程师最有价值。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved: 100% of his code is model-written, productivity per engineer up 200%, and the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场明显深化：编码几乎被解决，自 11 月起他 100% 的代码由 Claude Code 写成、不再手改一行，人均生产力提升约 200%，'软件工程师'头衔将让位于跨学科的'构建者'。

boris.en: Scaffolding is temporary tech debt: build for the model six months out, delete system prompts, and let the model figure it out.
boris.zh: 他反复强调不要给模型设限：脚手架只是临时技术债，应面向六个月后的模型构建，随新模型删除大部分系统提示与代码，给模型工具而非固定工作流，让它自己想办法。

boris.en: Safety is a first-class priority: coding is a clean domain for alignment research, and releasing early studies real-world behavior beyond internal evals.
boris.zh: 安全始终是主线：他把编码视为对齐研究的干净领域，有明确的对错结果；主张通过尽早发布来研究真实世界行为，因为内部评估不足以覆盖现实，并用多层'瑞士奶酪'式权限系统做遏制。

boris.en: The next abstraction is loops: agents prompt sub-agents, humans direct rather than write code, and the real value shifts to product sense and business.
boris.zh: 最近他进一步深化：智能体之后的下一个抽象层是循环，智能体能提示其他智能体、动态编排数千子智能体；人类角色转为指挥与教模型价值观，价值重心移向产品品味与商业能力，编程语言或将变得不再重要。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足、减少痛苦；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years is in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅限数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的多样数据能更快提升它。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling more efficient training.
qasaryounis.zh: 世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演进到神经模拟，从而实现更高效的训练。

derya.en: AI turns biology into engineering: agents automate hypotheses, experiments, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 把生物学变成工程学科：智能体自动完成假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体式发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现近乎 100% 疗效、零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed, and AI can reach intuition equal to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 可获得相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging reversal and 100% curable cancer follow, with superintelligence trusted for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 8–10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度；随后是衰老逆转与 100% 可治愈的癌症，医疗决策可近乎完全信任超级智能。

derya.en: The only existential threat is humanity itself; AI makes healthcare super affordable, and brain interfaces merge us with AI for Einstein-level intelligence.
derya.zh: 唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身；AI 让医疗变得极可负担，脑机接口让我们与 AI 融合，获得爱因斯坦级智能。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating history.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，历史不断重复。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, value moves to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向应用层转移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX; coding is the only clear PMF; LLMs give average answers.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人用户体验差；编程是唯一明确的 PMF；LLM 给出平均答案。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack; usage is shallow; enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中累积；使用仍浅层；企业采用需要重新构想工作流。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses let them be; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比我们当前的工具框架所能发挥的更聪明；工具框架工程意味着随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非一次性静态文档；随着模型变强，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts; excessive constraints hinder performance, so give reasons not prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明越需要精简、以原则驱动的提示；过度约束会损害表现，应给理由而非绝对禁令。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art more than science and unfit for zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自我指涉偏差；评估更像艺术而非科学，不适合从零到一的创新。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern; graph-based context and self-built context beat huge context windows for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为反模式；在编程中，基于图的上下文与模型自建上下文胜过超大上下文窗口。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并置于独立安全的环境中。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize; context overload hurts performance, and bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再逐步专业化；上下文过载会损害表现，而 bug 反而是产品市场契合的信号。

clairevo.en: The web is hostile to agents; APIs beat browser use, and politeness plus managerial skill improve outcomes.
clairevo.zh: 网络对智能体并不友好；API 优于浏览器操作，礼貌与管理能力都能改善结果。

clairevo.en: Solo founders orchestrate AI agents as a team; founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可把 AI 智能体编排成团队；创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察才是真正的护城河。

clairevo.en: Agents can own outcomes, but humans must own accountability; LLMs lack first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 智能体可以承担结果，但人类必须承担问责；大语言模型缺乏第一性原理的创造力。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习可能加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors and RLHF can incentivize sycophancy.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进系统，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search, and modularity are needed.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理、搜索与模块化。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and 'smells'; they are confident and fluent whether right or wrong, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知与“气味”；无论对错都自信流畅，侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Linguistic structure may return as a useful representation for reliability, despite end-to-end learning's dominance.
danklein.zh: 尽管端到端学习占主导，语言结构可能作为可靠性的一种有用表征回归。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily; product taste is the top skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: PM 必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天交付；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最重要的技能。

catwu.en: Clear goals and team principles enable autonomous decisions and fast shipping; the safe AGI mission unifies Anthropic for cross-org speed.
catwu.zh: 清晰的目标与团队原则让自主决策和快速交付成为可能；安全 AGI 的使命统一了 Anthropic，支撑跨组织快速行动。

catwu.en: Building automations to 100% reliability is crucial; 95% is not enough for real leverage.
catwu.zh: 把自动化做到 100% 可靠至关重要；95% 不足以产生真正的杠杆效应。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断；Claude Tag 已落地 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment; examples can hurt creativity.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示词通过移除示例和硬性约束缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型判断；给示例反而可能损害创造力。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good; a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine; humans can be removed from outer-layer code review.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是好事；代码库就是一份规格说明，有了好的测试套件，重写完全可行；外层代码审查可以移除人类。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 模型有用性的瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应被内化进模型权重，而不只是通过上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning, unlike lossy retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现更深层的组合与推理，这是有损的检索做不到的。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是许多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练模型，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低几个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning needs breakthroughs, small-model infrastructure, and integrated research-product loops; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights versus text.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习需要新突破、小模型基础设施和研产一体的闭环；模型应自主学会哪些知识存进权重、哪些留在文本里。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; scaling with more compute is not the only path—the next paradigm requires doing more with less.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径，下一个范式要求以更少资源做更多事。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; personalized continual learning will run on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 1000 万规模，更多 token 反而降低准确率；个性化持续学习将跑在端侧，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, variation, and genuine voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、差异与真实声音成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and over-reliance breaks the talent pipeline and apprenticeship.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们用不好 AI，过度依赖还会破坏人才梯队与学徒制。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, moving beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，不再只是来回对话式提示。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; the jagged frontier persists, and AI's opacity is likely permanent.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；能力锯齿状前沿依然存在，而 AI 的不透明性很可能是永久的。

ethanmollick.en: Organizations need a leadership, lab, and crowd model; taste is not uniquely human, and small-m management skills become crucial.
ethanmollick.zh: 组织需要领导层、实验室与群众模型；品味并非人类独有，小写 m 的管理技能变得关键。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as populations decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing without durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注，而模型正快速商品化、缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观听起来更高级，但往往是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented and person-centric: authenticity wins, the brand is the person, and corporate brands only made sense in the centralized media era.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体是进攻导向、以人为中心的：真实感取胜，品牌即个人，而企业品牌只在中心化媒体时代才说得通。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年时 Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期游戏才能获得复利回报。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI alignment is a joke; worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI itself.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年他更激进地称 AI 对齐是个笑话，真正该担心的是持有 AI 的不对齐人类，而非 AI 本身。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; agency matters more than intelligence.
naval.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将增长 9 万倍，开源模型与前沿模型差距缩小到 3-6 个月，人类的回报将从智能转向能动性。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。
