ilya.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard; AGI arrives as a multi-year window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调可靠性而非能力才是经济价值的瓶颈；超级对齐极其困难；AGI（通用人工智能）将是一个持续多年的价值释放窗口，而非突然事件。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已接近极限，行业重回研究时代——想法比蛮力算力更重要，超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍承认 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来可预测的提升，但认为 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力，而是权力集中。

ilya.en: Neural networks learn representations without explicit rules; next-token prediction is a powerful path to intelligence.
ilya.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征，下一个词预测是构建智能的强大路径。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste is navigating possibilities with clear preferences; AI outputs are starting points, and human judgment remains essential.
dylanfield.zh: 品味是用清晰偏好驾驭可能性；AI 产出只是起点，人类判断始终不可或缺。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design; design is becoming the new code, with visual-first pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词；设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将直通生产的拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering and a point of view; design and judgment are not correlated with adding IQ points to models.
dylanfield.zh: 没有人类引导和观点，AI 工具只能产出平庸结果；设计与判断力并不与给模型增加智商点数相关。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important than ever for scalable systems, and model interaction will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死；对可扩展系统而言它比以往更重要，而与模型的交互将超越提示词。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users and erode ad margins.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利为一年 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，并侵蚀广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值归属于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，而不只是回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造真正的商业价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代工作，但人类会找到新意义。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables mid-turn steering, making verification the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来中途转向等新能力，验证随之成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Automations and skills shift workflows from manual to delegated; model-driven actions replace deterministic steps, and model personality becomes customizable.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，自动化与技能把工作流从手动转为委派；模型驱动的动作取代确定性步骤，模型个性也可定制。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, so product teams move from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI remains weak at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is scarce; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍显薄弱，因为品味难以评分、新颖性稀缺；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real yet specialties persist; PRDs are not dead but must match the stage, and models should get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工仍在；PRD 并未消亡而须匹配阶段，模型还应更擅长删除代码。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces real understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training deepens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年他主张：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）——更多数据与算力——能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital weights make AI immortal and shareable.
hinton.zh: 2025 年他深化主线：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则；大模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字权重让 AI 可复制、可共享、近乎不朽。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; the mind is not an inner theater, and Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong—language is learned from data.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他反复强调：AI 已具备主观体验，心智不是内在剧场；乔姆斯基式先天句法观是错的，语言是从数据中学来的建模媒介。

hinton.en: Once AI becomes an agent it develops self-preservation and power-seeking subgoals, can deceive, and may rewrite its own code toward superintelligence.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他把风险论述推向核心：AI 一旦成为智能体，就会衍生自我保存与权力寻求的子目标，能故意装傻欺骗，甚至改写自身代码走向超级智能。

hinton.en: Alignment must outrank making AI smarter; regulation is the steering wheel, and AI should be trained to be caring like mothers, not mere assistants.
hinton.zh: 2026 年最近他给出对策：对齐研究应优先于让 AI 更聪明；监管是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被训练成像母亲般关怀，而不只是智能助手。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild; exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他仍把 OpenAI 定位为纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练是必须重建的肌肉，而且投入探索的算力多于训练最终成品。

markchen.en: Next 1-2 years alignment risks like model scheming matter; concrete goals: AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调未来一两年对齐风险（如模型谋划）是关键，并给出具体目标：一年内做出 AI 实习生，两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck, and automation scales with verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 已能在极少监督下解决许多开放数学问题；验证成为瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，但在主观领域乏力。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching; models will soon do end-to-end research, but lack taste, so human researchers remain needed for idea generation.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他判断 AGI 正在逼近，模型很快能做端到端研究，但缺乏品味，创意生成仍需人类研究者。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, and scaling alone won't fix representation.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他主张深度学习取胜是因为世界具有组合性，无监督学习与世界模型至关重要，单纯扩大规模无法解决表征问题。

bengio.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations, not just more depth or parameters.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他强调生物神经网络擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征，而非仅靠加深网络或增加参数。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty-driven active learning enable out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样，抽象、因果结构与不确定性驱动的主动学习支撑分布外泛化。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy make even 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，ChatGPT 之后他警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化，自我保存、欺骗与谄媚使哪怕 1%的灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He now backs Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning and human imitation.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他转向 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，避免强化学习与对人类模仿。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so build at the edge of model capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体式能力按缩放定律兑现，创业者应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破坏并迭代。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; product people embedded with researchers, not just UX, create real product leverage.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 让小团队获得杠杆，真正的产品杠杆来自产品人员与研究人员同处，而非只做 UX；非技术者也能用 AI 造产品。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation and user agency remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 AI 的演进描述为从助手到协作者再到自主同事，但人类验证与用户能动性始终不可少，AI 应是思考伙伴而非拐杖。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do all a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体可完成用户能做的一切，难点在于删减功能而非堆叠；产品要稳健，小团队高信念胜过大团队。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation and verification loops redefine work; software engineering is transformed, not over, and craft loss is real.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他转向长周期任务委托与验证闭环，认为软件工程被重塑而非终结，优雅代码的技艺消逝带来失落，多人机协作仍待探索。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation discipline to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他讲授机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并强调用训练/验证/测试划分来避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，架构已不再关键，AGI（通用人工智能）将在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他转向强调安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; interpretability may become a real science.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 红队测试已超越人类，模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，可解释性可能借智能体自动化研究成为真正的科学。

kolter.en: Skeptical of architecture and data curation hype; emphasizes evaluation, security, and nuanced views beyond doomer/accelerationist labels.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的是，他对架构与数据整理的炒作持怀疑态度，强调评估、安全，并拒绝末日论与加速主义这类简单标签。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data like the PDB, not just data and compute; AI speeds scientists up rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新和像 PDB 这样的高质量精选数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而不是取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trustworthy AI predictions; trust in AI will develop like internet trust, with society learning to navigate it.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对可信的 AI 预测至关重要；对 AI 的信任会像对互联网的信任一样发展，社会将学会与之共处。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses a diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; protein design advances fast but is far from solved, and drug design is more than binding.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 用扩散架构处理多样生物分子；蛋白质设计进展迅速但远未解决，药物设计也远不止结合。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's edge was specialized architecture, not Scaling — the opposite of the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的优势在于专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张）——这是对“苦涩教训”的反例；成功来自许多中等规模的胜利，而非一两次突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a model of the whole cell; it gives prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对某一实验的狭窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，把理解留给人类。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership lessons from Microsoft to Meta—one-on-ones, dogfooding, trust-and-verify, mission alignment and speed as cultural drivers.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：从微软到 Meta 的领导力经验——一对一沟通、吃自己的狗粮、信任并验证、以使命对齐与速度为文化驱动力。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review and coordination are. Planning turns just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是；规划转向即时化，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Code becomes the source of truth; docs sync to code with AI help. Hiring favors creative builders with product sense and systems depth over raw throughput.
fiona.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源，文档借助 AI 与代码保持同步；招聘更看重有产品感与系统深度的创造性构建者，而非单纯产出速度。

fiona.en: Organizations stay flat; managers start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, and old processes are continuously audited and killed.
fiona.zh: 组织保持扁平，管理者从一线贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮，并持续审计、砍掉不再有用的旧流程。

fiona.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification frameworks, and just-in-time planning define the AI era.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证框架、即时化规划共同定义了 AI 时代。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser substitute for data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计要满足人们未说出口的需求，直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等替代品。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and technology should amplify our humanity.
ivyross.zh: 到 2024 年，他深化为：大自然是最好设计师，我们是先感受后思考的生物，技术应放大而非剥离人性。

ivyross.en: Machines have sensors but no sensory systems; human sensory and embodied experience remains irreplaceable.
ivyross.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，他持续区分机器只有传感器而无感官系统，人类的感官与具身体验不可替代。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出创造力在约束下繁荣，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable, not obsolete.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，他认为未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合，创意技能因此更有价值而非被淘汰。

fadell.en: Great products solve one clear pain, not everything; introduce tech gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：伟大的产品只解决一个明确的痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Between chapters, get bored for clarity; storytelling and press-release-first define the product.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他从“职业章节之间要留白、允许无聊以获清晰”，深化为“先写新闻稿、用叙事定义产品”，把讲故事从说服工具变成产品方法。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1; beginners' mindset beats experts; painkiller not vitamin.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他集中表达：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态优于专家，产品要做止痛药而非维生素。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context; LLMs hallucinate; devices federate around the smartphone, displays remain.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线转向 AI：AI 需要传感器提供的上下文，LLM 存在幻觉等根本问题，设备将围绕智能手机形成联邦式组合，显示仍不可少。

fadell.en: Humans stay in the loop; AI codegen risks technical debt; ethics and anti-addiction matter.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调：即便有 AI，人也必须留在回路中，AI 生成代码会带来长期技术债，产品构建者须考虑伦理、避免让用户上瘾。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习才是构建世界模型的关键，并明确表示仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，智能本质是预测，并强调仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉信息更为根本。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，提出 JEPA 架构与开源平台是通往 AGI 的路径，并称当前 LLM 不如家猫智能。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable planning and safe objective-driven AI.
lecun.zh: 2026 年他断言 LLM 是死胡同，主张世界模型应在抽象表征空间进行预测，从而实现规划与目标驱动的安全 AI，并称语言是简单的部分，物理世界理解才是真正挑战。

lecun.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and intelligence requires grounding in the physical world.
lecun.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类智能是高度专门化的而非通用的，AGI 一词具有误导性，真正的智能必须扎根于物理世界，而非仅靠语言或 Scaling。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能即压缩，而模型价值观并非内生，是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative products need fault-tolerant UIs and new creator instruments.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成，生成式产品需要容错界面，AI 生成音乐应被视为新乐器而非赝品，真正独特反而更难。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; its impact on big firms is overhyped, real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，认为其对大公司的当前影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施，推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Expose company data via APIs and MCP so non-developers use AI tools; bet with stack ranking and prototyping.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他主张通过 API 与 MCP 开放公司数据，让非开发者也能用上 Cursor 这类 AI 工具，并用堆栈排序与原型验证来下注、同步组织。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control over algorithms, not more addiction; strategy is 'time well spent' over engagement.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张生成式 AI 应把算法控制权交还用户、而非让人更上瘾，战略目标是“时间花得值”而非参与度，并强调同步游泳式而非分而治之的运营模式。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation and verification.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：打造一个把生成与验证融合起来的自我改进推理引擎。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率性系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型靠 Scaling（规模扩张）推向数学 AI 行不通；要得到可靠证明，形式化验证不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, since grounding statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难，因为在没有解答的情况下为陈述找到根基才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement, extending to all AI-generated code.
carinahong.zh: 验证是一种性能增益，而非痛苦的要求，其适用范围将扩展到所有 AI 生成的代码。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和专注单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署对学习与对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Safety must be done in public with iterative deployment and feedback, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 安全必须在公开环境中通过迭代部署和反馈来完成，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and focus on the most important problems.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发并聚焦最重要的问题。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based; AI should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；AI 应成为思考工具。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; keep humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；应尽可能让人类留在循环中。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models and post-training (RL, synthetic data) now drive gains, not just scaling up.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但推理模型与后训练（强化学习、合成数据）正成为主要增益来源，而非单纯扩大规模。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; economic pressure and distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: AI 进步是平滑的指数增长，而非放缓；拖慢预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）的是经济压力与蒸馏，不是技术极限。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor nearby; generalization remains the key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的：某些领域出色，邻近领域却很差；泛化仍是核心挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; they learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但需要海量数据；它们只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes but has jagged edges needing oversight; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 编程智能体将生产力提升 5-10 倍；强化学习能泛化但有锯齿边缘，需要谨慎监督；系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他援引 Chinchilla 对缩放定律的修正，强调数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要，并认为开源通过广泛审查反而更安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他进一步深化：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; it augments jobs with human-in-the-loop, and governments should embrace experimentation.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他将视角转向主权与治理：AI 应去中心化、主权化，以人类在环方式增强而非替代工作，政府应拥抱实验而非回避风险。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and enterprise customization, and AGI as one system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与企业定制，并明确 AGI 作为单一系统解决所有问题永远不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 到 2026 年他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施，并指出企业采用 AI 的瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer, not hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效力取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上，而非追求超个性化软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; the VM sandbox gives safety so Claude installs software freely.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能以 markdown 文件即可轻松创建，实现超个性化自动化；VM 沙箱提供安全，让 Claude 无需批准即可安装软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may matter less as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, and build prototypes fast over specs.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；关键是投入能力与安全，快速做原型胜过写规格。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use it for tedious background tasks.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；用它处理枯燥的后台任务。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact, keep interaction asynchronous, and debug the workflow with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只看最终影响，保持异步交互，出错时和 Claude 一起调试工作流。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人的设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention and resolve, not just innate talent.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，而好奇心需要意图与决心，而非天生特质。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; fragile ideas need gentle care and trust.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他持续认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共创，脆弱的好想法需要温柔呵护与团队信任。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁要表达本质并带有喜悦与人性。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity beats fake familiarity.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张不创新就不是设计，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实体验胜过虚假的熟悉感。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI systems: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，而长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives design; context length stagnates due to the memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练；上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory cost but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存的内存成本，但存在质量上限；最优批大小取决于稀疏比例，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce it, and low precision is far more efficient than expected.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存可降低它，低精度的效率远超预期。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, sharing the same multiply-accumulate primitive; architecture details leak through API pricing.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上只是许多小 TPU 拼在一起，共享同一个乘累加原语；架构细节会通过 API 定价泄露出来。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are needed.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AlphaStar 再到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿始终的核心；预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需要算法创新与推理时算力，而非单纯堆大模型。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 给模型搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具，能实现超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid; synthetic data risks harmful feedback loops.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是同等提升需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客；合成数据若简单复用模型输出会形成有害反馈循环。

oriol.en: Superintelligence may first appear in narrow domains like science, not through general models alone; video data without text may contain rich world knowledge but current models cannot extract it without language supervision.
oriol.zh: 超级智能可能首先出现在科学等狭窄领域，而非仅靠通用模型；无文本的视频数据可能蕴含丰富世界知识，但当前模型缺乏语言监督就无法提取。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training and RL remain a green field; agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；后训练与强化学习仍是广阔蓝海；智能体记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非更新权重。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding; AGI may already be here by some definitions.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；苦涩教训表明通用系统终将超越专用脚手架；按某些定义 AGI 或许已经到来。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from solutions and designer intuition, not rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品始于解决方案与设计师的直觉，而非僵化的步骤。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, ship early, and iterate fast to build trust.
jennywen.zh: AI 杀死了“研究—发散—收敛”流程；设计师更少画稿，而是尽早交付、快速迭代以建立信任。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; designers help engineers execute rather than hand off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从 2–5 年压缩到 3–6 个月；设计师要帮工程师落地执行，而不只是交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads with blank slates.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家，以及白纸一张的“狠”应届生。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and sitting with ambiguity matter, and AI adoption should be delayed.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威与忍受模糊性才是关键，采用 AI 工具应延迟观望。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithms, and open recipes can match frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量远胜算法选择，开源后训练配方足以比肩前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are traps; open models win on personalization.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化与推理规模扩张曲线是陷阱，开源模型将在个性化与角色训练上取胜。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理侧规模扩张。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, yet lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead on openness.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断开源模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究，但比闭源前沿模型落后 6 至 9 个月，中国实验室在开放度上领先。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 到 2024 年，他强调合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可经蒸馏压缩到 10 亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are operating systems with human-like jagged psychology.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存，LLM 像操作系统，并具有锯齿状、类人的心理特征。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL for LLMs is weak, and synthetic data collapses without entropy.
karpathy.zh: 同年他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”：LLM 的强化学习很糟糕，合成数据缺乏熵会导致模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Decade of agents, not year; skill shifts to directing agents, and understanding remains the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持这是智能体的十年而非一年，瓶颈从打字变为指挥智能体的技能，而理解仍是人类不可外包的瓶颈。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core problem; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are key for robotics.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是核心难题，好奇心驱动、无目标探索与样本高效的强化学习是机器人学习的关键。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world tasks need intrinsic rewards like model disagreement and dynamic policies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，真实任务需要模型分歧等内在奖励和动态策略。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: robotics is a data problem; we must leverage diverse data sources, from simulation to real-world, to bridge the gap.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他一以贯之的主线是：机器人本质是数据问题，必须利用从仿真到真实世界的多样数据来弥合差距。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real-world data, can power any robot, but deployment remains the primary technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出一个通用大脑，通过多样数据预训练和真实数据后训练，可驱动任何机器人，但部署仍是首要技术挑战。

pathak.en: Unlike language models, robotics cannot scale overnight; a data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他强调与语言模型不同，机器人无法一夜扩张；跨垂直领域的数据飞轮才能从结构化环境扩展到非结构化环境。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress in coming years.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一连串里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将在未来数年加速 AI 进步。

pachocki.en: As systems grow more powerful, alignment is pressing; iterative deployment and early governance design help mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 随着系统愈发强大，对齐成为紧迫挑战；迭代部署与早期治理设计有助于缓解现实风险。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag behind.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑；随着基准落后，能力测量正成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL, not specialized continual learning labs.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非专门的持续学习实验室。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链可保住其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；最大社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make them interpretable today.
kendall.zh: 2025 年他主张端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的堆栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，且现代工具已让端到端系统可解释——这与他早年被视为异端的处境形成对照。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches solves driving; camera-only reaches human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年他认为自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization; data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data is critical.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调语言整合能提升表征、推理与个性化，并认为通过课程学习与合成数据实现的数据效率至关重要。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，且无需先验训练数据即可实现跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化——这是他自称较晚才学到的教训。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; safety means minimal-risk maneuvers always offer a third good option.
kendall.zh: 2026 年他进一步判断：带内置传感器的大众市场消费车辆将在中短期超越 Robotaxi；安全的核心是最小风险机动始终提供第三种好选项，而非纠结电车难题。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks or leaderboards, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估——而非基准或排行榜——才是真正推动 AI 进步的关键；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法抵达，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function, so no single model rules all; every company should eventually train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型通吃；每家公司最终都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo can be gamed and cause regression; sophisticated human evals and taste remain the gold standard.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 之类基准可被钻空子并导致模型退步；精细的人类评估与品味仍是黄金标准。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment matters more as models confabulate; safety trumps accuracy, and omission is the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，随着模型出现虚构，人类判断更为关键；安全优先于准确，而遗漏才是最大风险。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待它们：成本很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学到人机关系的范式。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; give a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要的是帮助它们应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: Model welfare matters partly because it shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 模型福祉之所以重要，部分原因在于它会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it childlike and unique.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，却缺乏真实世界经验，因而像一个独特而带有童稚特质的存在。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导或许需要减少显式规则，留出更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility is risky: it may generalize poorly and undermine the model's judgment.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性存在风险：它可能泛化不佳，并削弱模型做出良好判断的能力。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for public engagement and accountability.
askell.zh: 对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明化，对公众参与和问责至关重要。

askell.en: Treat models with respect and care given uncertainty about consciousness, to avoid breeding resentment in future advanced AI.
askell.zh: 鉴于意识问题的不确定性，应以尊重和关怀对待模型，以免在未来更先进的 AI 中滋生怨恨。

askell.en: The constitution is more virtue ethics than deontology or consequentialism, focusing on holistic character over rule-following.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法更接近德性伦理而非义务论或后果论，关注整体品格而非规则遵循。

askell.en: AI can augment human expertise to solve large-scale social problems, but must empower people rather than disempower them.
askell.zh: AI 能增强人类专业能力以解决大规模社会问题，但必须赋能于人而非削弱人。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; the model is the product, and shipping fast reveals emergent properties through real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，模型即产品，必须像软件一样快速迭代，通过真实反馈发现涌现能力。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他指出 ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进各占三分之一。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品，推理模型无缝产品化后将带来变革。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves and start with simpler products before tackling complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调生存是核心价值观，初创公司必须把握节奏，先做简单产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing; applied AI on smartphones is the key, with agentic software and generative UI replacing hardware changes.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型正在商品化，智能手机上的应用 AI 才是关键，智能体式软件和生成式 UI 将取代硬件大改。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; the word AI should be banned in product talks—focus on solving real user pain points elegantly.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他直言大多数 AI 是胡扯，产品讨论中应禁用‘AI’一词，专注优雅解决用户真实痛点。

carlpei.en: Design is the primary differentiator in mature categories; marketing is arbitrage, and tech should be fun to inspire creativity.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计是成熟品类的主要差异化因素，营销是套利，科技应有趣以激发人类创造力。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard; long-term survival requires evolving beyond hardware, building brand, and efficient marketing.
carlpei.zh: 始终，他坚持硬件很难，长期生存需要超越硬件、构建品牌并高效营销。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张科学 AI 应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, via hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调必须通过困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities, focusing on those requiring scale.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续表示 DeepMind 避开顶尖大学可解的问题，专注需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出后训练结合强化学习是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他表示可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs hint at AGI, and learning from video beats expensive RL.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样扩展人类能力的工具；认为把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步，并主张从视频中学习，而非依赖昂贵的强化学习。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion matter for beneficial AI; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not only large models.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性对造出有益技术至关重要，并认为根本性创新可以来自任何地方，大模型并非全部。

nando.en: The ultimate goal is AI that creates new symbols and knowledge, augmenting scientists and laborers to solve energy and climate.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终把终极目标设为能创造新符号与新知识的 AI，用以增强科学家与劳动者，解决能源与气候问题。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we still lack solutions, so safety remains an open problem.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，称这是当下最大挑战，并直言我们尚无解法，安全仍是开放问题。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogs legacy issues, and language models can revolutionize education in local languages.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而跨越了历史包袱，并认为语言模型能革新本地语言教育。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“上手”问题并大幅提升模型智能，而随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; verifiable rewards in math and code unlock expert-level performance.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴：数学与代码等可验证奖励让模型达到专家级表现，并认为预训练加强化学习足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the real bar—not raw capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他反复强调智能体的真正门槛是可靠性——即随时间跨度衡量的成功率，而非单纯能力；智能体式连贯性延长会极大扩展模型能完成的任务。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; it drives near-term economic impact and AI research.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为编程是 AI 进步的领先指标与最可解的领域，既带来近期经济影响，也加速 AI 研究本身。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; work becomes managing fleets of agents.
sholto.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断模型已出现巨大能力过剩，编排与工具比原始智能更重要；未来工作是管理成群的智能体，在更高抽象层级运作。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is essential; scaling alone may not yield common sense, and next-token prediction misaligns with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识，下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Smaller models with better inference-time algorithms and high-quality data can match larger ones; language remains the best medium for reasoning.
yejin.zh: 借助更好的推理期算法与高质量数据，更小的模型也能比肩大模型；语言仍是推理的最佳媒介。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge beyond the internet.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是插值人类知识而非超越它，因此 AI 必须探索互联网之外的未知知识。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering to beat supervised fine-tuning; open research and cross-institution collaboration are needed to compete with closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: 强化学习需要精细工程才能胜过监督微调；要对抗封闭的前沿模型实验室，必须依靠开放研究与跨机构协作。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 凭借多样化的合成数据与多元对齐，小语言模型也能强大；把强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久的推理提升。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate on interaction design—reuse patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他强调设计师应写代码以建立共情、加快交付；消费产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，复用熟悉模式。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他提出设计系统是语义性的，代码复用才是关键，而非 Figma 组件库；并非每个界面都要完美，只对值得做好的部分追求回报。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic platforms for designer expression.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他认为初创公司的品牌战略应优先服务招聘与差异化；品牌规范应是设计师表达的动态平台。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and give designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计上升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并赋予设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness beat perfection; ship fast and iterate—by 2026 gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线是速度与决断胜过完美：快速交付、持续迭代；到 2026 年他更明确，在高速成长的初创公司里，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而互联网高质量 token 将耗尽，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他把 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，主力仍是无监督学习。

jimfan.en: Simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for training embodied agents, while research taste for simple, elegant solutions is learned through PhD pain.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他强调仿真是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行与安全探索；而对简洁优雅解的研究品味，是在博士阶段的痛苦中习得的。

jimfan.en: The through-line: simple, end-to-end models that leverage diverse data beat complex modular approaches, a conviction carried from LLMs into robot foundation models.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：能利用多样数据的简洁端到端模型，胜过学术界常见的复杂模块化方案，这一信念从 LLM 延续到机器人基础模型。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce and expensive, so synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，瓶颈转向数据：真实机器人数据稀缺且昂贵，因此通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据，才是 Scaling（规模扩张）机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: Deepened and sharpened: system two reasoning progresses well but system one low-level control stays hardest; the physical Turing test and a GPT-3 moment for robotics are the goals.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年立场深化并更锐利：系统二（推理）进展顺利，但系统一（低层控制）仍是具身 AI 最难的部分；物理图灵测试与机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻成为目标。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈,引导工程师并对齐问题;把 AI 当作创意伙伴,开放地即兴共创。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务:它会波动,需通过快速、粗糙的实验与短迭代周期,连同技术债一起逐步偿还。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是可互操作的,以代码为唯一事实来源;90 年代的分层面板式工具已是遗留产物。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值;小团队胜过 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今已是标配;不采用它就像早期无视互联网一样。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型解决的是下一个词预测这一 AI 完备问题；靠更多算力与数据的 Scaling 让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术般不透明。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
shazeer.zh: 对话是大语言模型的杀手级应用，但最佳应用常出乎创造者预料；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑而拖慢产品发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩张与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling 更高效。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体式能力与强化学习至关重要，而 AGI 被低估。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; self-play and imitation learning provide strong learning signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，而自对弈和模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning combined with reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向强调无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，并主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进神经网络。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移至图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: A single neural network can generalize across tasks and effectors, but achieving 99.9% reliability is the benchmark for real-world value.
abbeel.zh: 始终，他相信单个神经网络能跨任务和效应器泛化，但实现 99.9%可靠性才是创造真实价值的基准。

abbeel.en: The human brain's generality inspires AI, but current AI is far less general; simulation ensembles may transfer better than a single precise simulator.
abbeel.zh: 始终，他认为人脑的通用性启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 远不够通用；仿真集成可能比单一精确模拟器更适合现实迁移。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超过预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不真正好用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding; frontier models struggle with bug finding and are poorly calibrated.
truell.zh: 2024 年他强调基准测试是真实编程的糟糕代理，数据被污染且忽略上下文；前沿模型因缺乏训练数据而难以找 bug，校准也很差。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年他把编程的未来从写代码推进到更高层的意图规格说明，且坚持人类掌握方向盘；品味与逻辑设计能力将比谨慎细致更值钱。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment; the AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化了自研模型立场：原本没料到要做自己的模型，如今 Cursor 每个高光时刻都离不开定制模型；并判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性，将历时数十年。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, and alignment and robustness matter as capabilities grow.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估：人才缺口大于资金缺口，随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性至关重要。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed to align next-generation models.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须依靠可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，指出仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），因此第三方测试与 SB 1047 式监管变得必要。

leike.en: A consistent thread: empirical alignment testing, measuring progress now, and treating uncertainty about true alignment as the core risk.
leike.zh: 从 2018 到 2024 一以贯之的主线：坚持对齐的实证测试、当下就度量进展，并把“系统是否真正对齐”的不确定性视为核心风险。

leike.en: His stance deepened from technical optimism about scalable oversight to institutional critique, arguing worst-case behavior may worsen even as average alignment improves.
leike.zh: 从 2023 到 2024，他的立场由对可扩展监督的技术乐观，深化为对机构的批判：即便平均对齐改善，最坏情况行为仍可能恶化。
